<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Prix et paywall.**
      1 avis récent mentionne prix et paywall.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 5 oct. 2026 - 5 oct. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent prix, abonnements ou paywalls. Cela peut signaler une sensibilité au pricing dans la niche.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _T Brown_, 5 oct. 2026, 1/5: "Nothing works anymore. It was the best a year and a half ago. Now it is garbage. If you want an expensive smartwatch that actually does what it is supposed to do, don't buy Samsung. In Korean so that you understand: 여러분이 정확히 이해할 수 있도록 한국어로 작성합니다: 더 이상 아무것도 제대로 작동하지 않습니다. 1년 반 전에는 정말 최고의 제품이었지만, 지금은 형편없습니다. 제대로 작동하는 비싼 스마트워치를 원한다면 삼성 제품은 구매하지 마세요."

## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      4 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 24 juil. 2026 - 6 oct. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Annette Duhon_, 6 oct. 2026, 1/5: "I have abandoned this app. (My issues are still detailed in the review edit history.) I wouldn't have spent so much time on this review if hadn't spent so much dang money on this Galaxy Watch 8, which I REALLY regret. I'm not even mad anymore. I now use Google Health as far as Health Connect will sync to it, and I use Medisafe for tracking my medications."
            2. _andrew morrow_, 3 oct. 2026, 1/5: "Samsung health step count doesn't work on their new flagship watch, the ultra 2. It'll only track for so long and if the watch reboots or updates the software then the step count freezes and won't accurately count your steps without your phone at hand. Samsung have responded by telling me to reset the watch everytime....... This is the third time since August!"
            3. _Daniel Baumbart_, 27 sept. 2026, 1/5: "202609: app doesn't crash a lot anymore but I can't delete wrong automatic entries in sleep so the data is wrong and will get worse over time :( 202509: crashes a lot since the newest update"
<!--/ir-theme-->
